g.text: Admission depends on the fitted training partition

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: Each original scenario is evaluated once in each repeat; five appearances are repeated fits on one market path.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: Matrix: blue = automated, pale gold = execution Review, grey = Q1 Review, white = outside Balanced.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #242b32

g.text: β controls the complete-training breach cap; η is a technical price. Different selected prices need not imply different actions.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #242b32

g.text: Every outer fit uses 96 training paths and four inner 72-path fits; cross-fit changes cannot be attributed to changing sample size.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #242b32

g.text: Each fit makes one admission decision for all 24 held-out paths before their returns; frequencies track held-out fits.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #242b32

g.text: Repeated development paths and overlapping training fits are not 600 independent markets or 25 independent deployment trials.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #242b32
